title: Restriction of evaluated normalized singleton tensor sections
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F a quasi-coherent X-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], U and W étale X-objects, g:W→U, n a natural number, and j∈Fin(n+2). Suppose f and f′ are degree n and n+1 comparison homomorphisms satisfying the pure-tensor normalization [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. For any coefficient section m over U and functions b:Fin(n+1)→Γ(W,O), restrict the evaluated section f(up(m tensor tprod(b))) along the product map omitting j. The result equals the evaluated section f′(up(m tensor tprod(j.insertNth 1 b))). Evaluation means categorical projection at the constant-zero tuple followed by ULift.down, and the product map is Pi.lift of the j.succAbove projections. This is an identity of geometric sections; it makes no assertion about the Čech coface.

source.place: Tag 03P2, Theorem 59.22.4, affine singleton Čech/Amitsur identification; Tag 03DR, equation 35.8.0.1

proof.text:
apply hf to evaluate the input section as the product of pulled-back
functions times the restriction of m from U. Semilinearity of
etaleTensorSectionsRestriction moves that scalar product outside restriction.
A ring homomorphism preserves finite products. For each k, the product map
omitting j followed by the k-th projection is the j.succAbove(k)-th projection,
by Pi.lift_π. Functoriality of appTop therefore identifies each pulled-back
scalar with the corresponding retained projection function on the larger
product. Composition of etaleTensorSectionsRestriction and the over-U
triangle identify the restricted coefficient with direct restriction from U.
Apply hf' to evaluate the inserted-unit pure section. Its j-th scalar factor
is the pullback of one and equals one. Fin.prod_univ_succAbove, together with
insertNth at j and at j.succAbove(k), identifies its remaining factors with
those just computed. Thus the evaluated sections agree. This argument has
no Čech coface and no injectivity assertion. It works in degree zero, for
both possible omitted factors, and for zero modules and empty schemes. Lean implementation: the fully proved private equality-witness wrapper pinnedValue fixes each restriction map by equality to its original value. Apply semilinearity and composition to these equal maps, using comp_over_pinned_apply for the over-U triangle. This avoids kernel reduction of the normalized adjunction maps during evaluation. Evaluate hf and hf-prime and transport their coefficient restrictions to the pinned maps using seal_eq. Pi.lift_π proves projection composition, map_prod and Fin.prod_univ_succAbove compute the scalars, and equality transitivity combines these calculations. Every private helper and the equality witness theorem are fully proved; no mathematical definition or statement changes.

proof_origin.place: Explicit part of the original coface node proof, using Tags 03P2 and 03DR, both read on 2026-10-13. B2 formalized the existing restriction argument in Lean on 2026-10-13. Equality-witness wrappers are an implementation device only, with every defining witness proved equal to the original map; no holes were added.

theorem singletonTensor_normalized_restriction
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (f' : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X (n + 1) ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X (n + 1))
    (hf : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f)
    (hf' : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g (n + 1) f')
    (m : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤))
    (b : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(W.left, ⊤)) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) := g.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F (Pi.lift (fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g) (j.succAbove k))).left
      (((Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1 ↦
      AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
        Γ((Modules.tensorPullback
          (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)).left.hom).obj F, ⊤)))
      (fun _ ↦ 0)) (f (ULift.up (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)] PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) b)))).down) =
    ((Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) → Fin 1 ↦
      AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1}
        Γ((Modules.tensorPullback
          (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 2) ↦ Over.mk g)).left.hom).obj F, ⊤)))
      (fun _ ↦ 0)) (f' (ULift.up (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)]
        PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) (j.insertNth 1 b))))).down
